title: The ordered F-system for the F-method and differential symmetry breaking operators for $(GL(3,\mathbb{R}), GL(2,\mathbb{R}))$
summary: In this paper, we introduce a new aspect of the F-system for the F-method arising in the case where the nilpotent radical is not necessarily abelian. For this, we define the symmetrization operator on the space of polynomial functions on the dual $\mathfrak{g}^\vee$ of a finite-dimensional Lie algebra $\mathfrak{g}$. In the context of the F-method, the conjugation by this operator of the F-system yields a new system, which we call the ordered F-system.
